name: Full map POI-style logarithmic zoom slider

steps._note: NOT RUN. User opens Map at5120x1440/current UI scale and other supported aspects. Confirm purple Detail-to-Overview slider sits inside bottom-right map edge without covering filters or sidebar.

User clicks both endpoints and midpoint; drags track/handle; releases outside; verifies immediate map scale and visible-width label. Wheel over track/background and gamepad triggers must keep slider synchronized. Ctrl-right-click the control must not teleport; dragging it must not pan the viewport.

Close/reopen and resize/change Purge legend or static mode. Check no stale drag, clipping, lost native wheel/gamepad controls or changed valid-world teleport behavior. No automated game control/teleport in this scenario.
